title: Scaffold npm workspace and Compose skeleton
acceptance_notes: Workspace commands run and four local services have health checks.

title: Create metadata schema and migrations
acceptance_notes: Dataset versions, runs, and audit events persist in PostgreSQL.

title: Enforce OIDC roles on API routes
acceptance_notes: Release owners can mutate; reviewers are read-only; denials are audited.

title: Validate and version JSONL uploads
acceptance_notes: Reject invalid UTF-8, oversize files, bad rows, and duplicate case IDs atomically.

title: Create run API and state transitions
acceptance_notes: Run snapshots dataset version and follows the accepted state model.

title: Execute runs with deterministic mock adapter
acceptance_notes: A fixed adapter configuration yields repeatable outcome and latency fixtures.

title: Write redacted audit event pipeline
acceptance_notes: Required metadata is captured without dataset rows, tokens, or secret values.

title: Build authenticated application shell
acceptance_notes: Routes expose role-aware navigation and accessible loading/error states.

title: Build dataset upload experience
acceptance_notes: Client shows server validation results without logging row content.

title: Build run launch experience
acceptance_notes: Release owner can select a version and launch the mock run once.

title: Build run status and score summary
acceptance_notes: Queued-to-terminal status and four Sprint 1 summary metrics are readable.

title: Cover core API and security contracts
acceptance_notes: Tests cover roles, validation atomicity, transitions, determinism, and redaction.

title: Automate core-flow browser smoke test
acceptance_notes: Playwright covers upload, launch, poll, and summary in the local stack.

title: Add pull-request quality gates
acceptance_notes: CI runs lint, typecheck, API tests, and browser smoke before merge.

title: Specify keyboard and failure-state behavior
acceptance_notes: Upload and run flows have keyboard order plus actionable empty/error copy.

title: Connect to a live external model provider
acceptance_notes: Blocked pending Sprint 3 security review; no live credentials in Sprint 1.

title: Deploy managed cloud production environment
acceptance_notes: Cloud deployment follows local product validation.

title: Add locally managed password authentication
acceptance_notes: Rejected by accepted OIDC decision.

title: Export raw dataset rows in audit log
acceptance_notes: Rejected because audit logs must not retain dataset content.

title: Add cost analysis dashboard
acceptance_notes: Explicitly outside the Sprint 1 score summary.
